text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Great aspirations have been realized and

boundless blessings have come our way.
Since she
took on the challenge of the
Twinkle Series,
Matikanefukukitaru has
achieved considerable
success.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With our three-year roller coaster ride
coming to
an end, only now can I heave
this huge weight off
my shoulders. Just
as I'm about to take a
breather...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ta-dah! You don't even have to call my
name, yet
here I am! Happiness is always
around the corner!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I bet you Mati-can't live without me,
right? You
must have been dying to see
me again. Well, it's
your lucky day!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Don't be so cold, Trainer! You're my
destined
partner! You should look
overjoyed when you see
me!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, I'd like to take you on a tour of
sacred
sites today as thanks for all
you've done for me.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
To ensure that many blessings continue
to come
your way, I'm going to share
with you some of my
good luck! How's
that sound?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I decide to take her up on the invitation.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Oh, look! See that lucky cat statue
outside that
bar?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
It used to be a tanuki, but they painted
over it.
That's what makes this sight such
a rarity. How
wondrous and spiritual!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
This here is a heavenly arcade. Winning
the top
prize in the claw machine is easy
as pie.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
If you end up spending a fortune with
nothing to
show for it, the kind and
thoughtful staff
members will give it to
you anyway.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
It's not just the arcade that's heavenly.
The
customer service is too.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Agh! Okay, let me show you one more!
This last
sacred site outclasses all the
rest. Trust me!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Do you recognize this shrine?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Uh-huh. However, turns out this very
shrine is
actually the strongest sacred
site there is.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: I learned a new myth recently.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Long, long ago, there was a girl who
came to this
shrine.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
The girl wanted her wishes to come true,
but
didn't know where to start. She was
at a complete
loss.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
That's when a messenger of the gods
appeared
before her. Their mission was
to make her wishes
a reality.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
The messenger bestowed upon her a
miraculous
power. With it, she could
leap across the Milky
Way and take stars
into the palms of her hands.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Pretty amazing, right? Don't you think a
myth like
that makes for an unparalleled
sacred site?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Apparently, the girl was very grateful for
her gift.
Or at least, that's how the story
goes.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seems like Fukukitaru brought me here
to
express her gratitude.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Here's what I think. What she was really
grateful
for...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Had nothing to do with her wish being
granted.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
The time she got to spend with the
messenger!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Sometimes she won, and sometimes she
lost.
Sometimes things went well, and
sometimes they
didn't...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
But whatever happened, she was always
happy.
From the bottom of m—

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Her! I mean her! I'm talking about the
girl, not me!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I messed up the story a bit, but you get
the gist,
right?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
So, what do you think? Can we consider
this
shrine to be the best sacred site
around?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Maybe a "sacred site" doesn't need
inherent
power.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sometimes, a chance encounter ends up
as a
precious part of someone's life.

Matikanefukukitaru's triumphs and
struggles have
turned this shrine into a
very special place.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, shall we get moving? That's all I
wanted
to tell you!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Just so you know, this isn't goodbye for
us. The
string of fate tying us together is
made of steel!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's not like her to come to a shrine and
not draw
a fortune slip.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: I'll give it a miss for today.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I'm fine, really. Why don't we go and get
some
sweet red bean soup?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
(Thing is... I don't need to test my luck
to know
the answer.)

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: (Today's my lucky day. I mean—)

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
(There's someone beside me to share my

happiness with!)
